title: OpenConstruction Task Vocabulary
description: Controlled vocabulary and lightweight taxonomy for benchmarkable computer vision, multimodal, BIM, and AEC task labels used across OpenConstruction catalogs.

categories.name: Recognition and Classification
categories.description: Tasks that assign labels to scenes, objects, events, defects, text, or BIM entities.

categories.name: Detection and Localization
categories.description: Tasks that detect, localize, track, or estimate object, action, pose, or change instances.

categories.name: Segmentation and Parsing
categories.description: Tasks that partition images, videos, floor plans, point clouds, or BIM content into structured regions or classes.

categories.name: Reconstruction and Registration
categories.description: Tasks that recover geometry, align representations, or reconstruct models from observations.

categories.name: Generation and Synthesis
categories.description: Tasks that generate images, layouts, scenes, models, captions, or other derived artifacts.

categories.name: Retrieval and Search
categories.description: Tasks that retrieve relevant cases, layouts, BIM information, ontologies, or other structured knowledge.

categories.name: Prediction and Recommendation
categories.description: Tasks that forecast future behavior or recommend actions, commands, or pathways.

categories.name: Reasoning, QA, and Information Extraction
categories.description: Tasks involving multimodal reasoning, question answering, graph reasoning, or extraction of structured information.

categories.name: Mapping, Navigation, and Spatial Understanding
categories.description: Tasks centered on mapping, localization, depth, visualization, or spatial scene understanding.

categories.name: Planning, Simulation, and Optimization
categories.description: Tasks focused on workflow planning, simulation, modeling, or optimization for design and construction processes.

categories.name: BIM and CAD Authoring
categories.description: Tasks that create, query, automate, or author BIM and CAD models or workflows.

categories.name: Analysis and Assessment
categories.description: Tasks that estimate, assess, count, or analyze domain-specific properties, risks, or lifecycle metrics.

tasks.description: Reconstructs a BIM model from 2D drawings, floor plans, or other 2D inputs.
Detects and localizes object instances in 3D data such as point clouds or meshes.

tasks.scope_note: Use for generic recovery of 3D geometry or scene structure. Prefer narrower labels such as Structure from motion, BIM reconstruction, or 3D registration when those are the actual benchmark targets.
tasks.description: Recovers 3D geometry or structure from images, video, scans, or other observations.

tasks.scope_note: Use for geometric alignment and registration problems, including scan-to-BIM alignment.
tasks.description: Aligns two or more 3D representations into a common coordinate frame.

tasks.scope_note: Use when semantic labeling is defined over generic 3D representations such as point clouds, voxels, meshes, or surfaces. Prefer Point cloud segmentation when the benchmark is explicitly point-cloud-centric.
tasks.description: Assigns semantic class labels to points, voxels, or surfaces in 3D data.
Estimates full 6-degree-of-freedom position and orientation for an object or camera.
Classifies the action occurring in an image sequence or video clip.
Evaluates agents on reading, navigating, and reasoning over architectural drawing sets and related project documents.
Detects and temporally localizes activities or events in video or sensor streams.
Checks whether a design, model, or process satisfies specified codes, rules, or constraints.
Automates BIM model creation through agents, commands, or high-level instructions.
Learns to imitate demonstrated actions or interaction sequences from examples.
Automates BIM authoring, editing, checking, or related software workflows.
Recommends the next BIM command or operation based on user context or history.
Assigns semantic or type labels to objects represented in BIM content.
Retrieves structured information from BIM models in response to user or system queries.

tasks.scope_note: Use as the broad parent concept for modality-specific BIM reconstruction tasks. Prefer the narrower modality-specific task when the input source is explicit.
tasks.description: Recovers BIM geometry or semantics from drawings, scans, text, or other observations.
Detects buildings or building footprints in imagery, maps, or remote sensing data.
Builds or predicts energy models and related thermal performance for buildings.
Localizes buildings or their positions in spatial or visual data.
Generates CAD geometry, drafting content, or parametric design artifacts.
Finds relevant prior cases, examples, or precedents for a current problem.
Detects whether meaningful change has occurred between two observations of the same scene.
Segments the spatial extent of changes between two or more observations.
Optimizes plans, designs, or operations with respect to cost objectives.
Detects cracks in images, video, or structural sensing data.
Recognizes worker or crew activities from video or site observations.
Classifies the type or severity of damage present in a structure or component.

tasks.scope_note: Use for broad defect or anomaly detection when the defect type is not restricted to a narrower domain.
tasks.description: Detects defects, anomalies, or quality issues in inspected assets or materials.
Estimates per-pixel or per-point depth from images or other sensor observations.

tasks.scope_note: Use when the output is an asset- or environment-level digital twin intended for downstream simulation, monitoring, or asset management rather than only synthetic scene creation.
tasks.description: Generates digital twin representations of assets, systems, or environments.
Recognizes disaster-related scenes, conditions, or event categories from observations.
Estimates embodied carbon impacts for materials, assemblies, or projects.
Creates or supports augmented, mixed, or virtual reality representations and interactions.
Generates finite element models from geometry, BIM, or other engineering inputs.
Segments rooms, walls, symbols, or regions in floor plan images or drawings.
Generates BIM structure or geometry from floor plans.
Analyzes spatial patterns, regions, or geographic relationships in map-based data.
Simulates ground-penetrating radar responses or data for subsurface analysis.
Plans executable GUI action sequences to accomplish a software workflow.
Detects interactions between people and objects in images or video.
Generates natural language descriptions for image content.
Assigns one or more class labels to an image.
Fills missing, masked, or corrupted image regions with plausible content.
Generates new images from noise, prompts, conditioning signals, or structured inputs.
Estimates kinematic motion quantities from imagery or video.
Transforms an input image into another image domain while preserving relevant structure.
Retrieves relevant documents, passages, records, or knowledge items for a query.
Segments each object instance separately rather than assigning only semantic classes.
Builds graph-structured knowledge representations from source data or documents.
Performs reasoning or inference over graph-structured knowledge.
Retrieves relevant layouts, floor plans, or arrangement exemplars from a database.
Generates spatial layouts, arrangements, or floor plan configurations.
Models lifecycle impacts, inventories, or sustainability outcomes across project phases.
Generates detailed building models at Level of Development 4 or comparable fidelity.
Counts materials, components, or item quantities from project data or observations.
Analyzes how materials move through a system, facility, or lifecycle process.
Generates outputs conditioned on multiple modalities such as text, image, geometry, or sensor signals.
Identifies and labels entities such as assets, organizations, locations, or materials in text.
Predicts the most likely next action in a sequence of user or agent behavior.
Detects and localizes object instances in images, video, or related observations.
Segments object regions from background or surrounding context.
Tracks object identities and trajectories across frames or time steps.
Searches ontology concepts, terms, or structured knowledge vocabularies.
Predicts likely pathways, trajectories, or downstream process routes.

tasks.scope_note: Use for correspondence or matching between point cloud content and BIM elements. Prefer 3D registration for the broader geometric alignment problem.
tasks.description: Matches point cloud content with BIM elements or structures.

tasks.scope_note: Use as the canonical generation term for both general and synthetic point cloud generation.
tasks.description: Generates point cloud representations from models, images, simulation, or learned latent signals.

tasks.scope_note: Use when the benchmark is explicitly defined on point clouds. Prefer 3D semantic segmentation when the task is described more generally over multiple 3D representation types.
tasks.description: Segments regions or object classes within point cloud data.
Produces visual displays or navigable views for point cloud content.
Estimates the position, orientation, or articulated pose of an entity.
Generates automatically inferred labels for self-training or weakly supervised learning.

tasks.scope_note: Use as the broad QA task when the evidence modality is not restricted to a specific visual input type.
tasks.description: Answers questions using textual, structured, or multimodal evidence.
Extracts structured relationships between entities from text or other data.
Estimates, scores, or ranks safety, schedule, quality, or operational risk.
Estimates feasible robot grasp poses for manipulation tasks.
Plans sensor viewpoints, trajectories, or acquisition strategies for scanning.
Creates BIM representations from scan or point cloud data.

tasks.scope_note: Use for synthetic or procedural environment creation. Prefer Digital twin generation when the goal is a faithful operational representation of a real asset or environment.
tasks.description: Generates synthetic scenes, environments, or scene-level content.
Detects semantically meaningful changes between BIM versions or between BIM and observations.
Builds maps that include semantic labels in addition to geometry or occupancy.

tasks.scope_note: Use as the broad semantic labeling task when the input modality does not require a dedicated specialization.
tasks.description: Assigns a semantic class label to each pixel, region, or observation unit.
Recommends the next item or action by modeling sequential user or process behavior.
Classifies sewer defects by type or severity from inspection data.
Generates simulation-ready models from design, BIM, or engineering data.
Jointly estimates agent pose and a map of the surrounding environment.
Detects structural defects such as corrosion, cracks, spalling, or deformation.

tasks.scope_note: Use when the benchmark explicitly focuses on recovering camera poses and sparse or dense structure from overlapping images, rather than generic 3D reconstruction.
tasks.description: Recovers camera poses and 3D structure from multiple overlapping images.
Assigns labels or categories to text documents, passages, or user inputs.
Generates BIM content directly from natural language descriptions.
Predicts future trajectories of agents, objects, or equipment.
Answers questions that require temporal reasoning over video content.

tasks.scope_note: Use when the task requires multimodal reasoning over visual and language inputs but is not primarily evaluated as a question-answering benchmark.
tasks.description: Performs joint reasoning over visual and language inputs.
Localizes image or scene regions that correspond to a language expression.
Answers questions grounded in images or other static visual inputs.
